title: Member-Since Upgrade Credit
content:
When a membership of Northgate Memberships is upgraded to a Plus tier, the member-since upgrade credit is taken off the upgrade fee.

| Whole months from the date the membership was opened to the upgrade date | Member-since upgrade credit |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 8.00 dollars |
| 48 to 95 | 4.00 dollars |
| fewer than 48 | none |

**Wording.** The member-since upgrade credit is 8.00 dollars when the membership was opened 96 or more whole months before the upgrade date, 4.00 dollars when it was opened 48 to 95 whole months before, and nothing when it was opened fewer than 48 whole months before.

**Counting whole months.** Whole calendar months from the opening date shown on the membership to the upgrade date; a month counts only when the upgrade date's day of the month has reached the opening date's day of the month. The opening date is the date the membership was first purchased and does not change on renewals or tier changes.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Opened | Upgrade date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June 2019 | 14 June 2027 | 95 | 4.00 |
| 15 June 2019 | 15 June 2027 | 96 | 8.00 |
| 15 June 2023 | 14 June 2027 | 47 | none |
| 15 June 2023 | 15 June 2027 | 48 | 4.00 |
